snippet.title: Night Concierge — Official Trailer | PS1-Style Horror | Steam, Nov 26 2026
snippet.description:
November 2003. Night shift at the front desk of a post-Soviet apartment block. Something is wearing your neighbors' faces. Check the resident log, question visitors over the intercom and call their apartment: if they answer from home, who's at the door?

🗓 Coming to Steam: November 26, 2026 (15:00 UTC)
💸 20% off for the first two weeks
⭐ Wishlist now so Steam reminds you at launch:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5458540/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=trailer_v10_en

Night Concierge is a short PS1-style first-person horror game with multiple endings and a Twitch streamer mode: chat votes on who to let in and plays pranks on you.

Languages: English, Russian, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), Simplified Chinese.

Русский трейлер: https://youtu.be/xEANtwlMY_w

#NightConcierge #horrorgame #indiegame
